reviews.text: Such a healthy good alternative to drinking soda; the taste and the fizz makes it feel like you're drinking soda. It's a bit artificial at times, but most of the time, you won't notice the difference
reviews.zh: 代替汽水嘅健康好選擇；味道同汽泡令你感覺似飲緊汽水。有時會有少少人工感，但係大部分時間你都唔會覺得有分別。

reviews.text: I like the taste! For me it is like sugarfree Sprite! I love it. I've tried kombucha before but that tasted like some kind of beer for me... this is tasty. I'm drinking it with sparkling water.
reviews.zh: 我鍾意個味！對我嚟講好似無糖雪碧咁！好鍾意。我之前飲過康普茶，但係嗰個對我嚟講好似啤酒咁……呢款好好飲。我係配梳打水飲。

reviews.text: I got them 10 minutes ago and I've already tried one with cold sparkling water. It's like sprite but without sugar. The best thing ever!!! My mom also liked it and I will surely order more.
reviews.zh: 我10分鐘前先收到，已經試咗一支，配冰梳打水飲。好似無糖雪碧咁。最好飲嘅嘢！！！我媽媽都好鍾意，我一定會再訂多啲。

reviews.text: i feel psychologically healthy after taking one sachet. it taste so healthy and nice to drink. I feel tempted to consume it directly into my mouth and please don't do like me. once in contact with my saliva, it gets bubbling like a soda water in my mouth, it's not fun.
reviews.zh: 飲完一包之後，我心理上覺得好健康。味道好健康，飲落好好味。我忍唔住想直接倒入口食，請你唔好學我。一接觸到我嘅口水，佢就喺我口入面起泡，好似汽水咁，唔好玩。

reviews.text: I was surprised about the quality, taste is amazing, very natural, i do not feel like drinking something with artificial flavourings. Taste is well balanced. It has nice little bubbles so it's really refreshing.
reviews.zh: 我對品質感到驚訝，味道好正，非常天然，我唔會覺得飲緊有人工香料嘅嘢。味道平衡得好好。有啲細細粒嘅氣泡，所以真係好清爽。

reviews.text: Soo I buy this brand all the time. The lemon flavour and the peach flavour. I’m addicted. It really helps me so much. I would drink this all day if possible. For now I do 1 sachet a day. And I prefer it in the evening, or after dinner.
reviews.zh: 所以我一直都買呢個品牌，檸檬味同蜜桃味都買。我上癮咗。佢真係幫我好多。如果可以，我成日都想飲。而家我每日飲一包。我比較鍾意喺晚上，或者食完晚飯之後飲。

reviews.text: i quite like this drink, i’m not sure if it actually helps lose weight but honestly the taste is pretty nice and if you drink it after a heavy meal, you feel lighter and better
reviews.zh: 我幾鍾意呢款飲品，唔肯定佢係咪真係有助減肥，但係老實講味道幾好，如果喺大餐之後飲，會覺得身體輕啲、舒服啲。

reviews.text:
Im alway a bit skeptical when i have to try anything that has to dissolve in water, but i was positively surprised. 
The powder dissolves complete and it haas a really nice citrus tase. 
It does however taste a bit like vitamin c powder supplements.
reviews.zh:
我每次要試吓任何需要溶喺水入面嘅嘢，都會有啲懷疑，但係我好正面咁感到驚喜。
粉末完全溶晒，有好好聞嘅柑橘味。
不過，佢嘅味道有少少似維他命 C 粉補充劑。
